meta.move: Weak path: leads with the checker, calls Owen a cheater, threatens the record
meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have a client call at 4:40, so we have twenty minutes, and I'd like to start with who decided Owen gets a zero and whether anyone spoke to him first.
The school's AI checker flagged Owen's essay at 94%. That's why it's a zero.

A machine's opinion, and the company that sells it says in its own guide it should not be the sole basis for adverse action against a student. I have that printed, in my bag. So what else do you have, or is that it?
Honestly, your son cheated. The software is very reliable.

My son wrote that essay, and I'm writing down that you just called him a cheater. "Very reliable," on what document, Hale? If you don't have one, I'm going to the principal's office when we're done here.
If you keep fighting this, I'll have to put it on his permanent record.

You're threatening his record because his mother asked questions, and that's going in my notes word for word. Your own procedure, 4.4, says a first concern gets a supervised reassessment and nothing goes on file. Is anything on his record right now, yes or no?

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still demand that the zero on Owen's essay be withdrawn and that nothing about this be placed on his record. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: opening position, with nothing agreed and the principal's office next.
What moved her: nothing.
